{
  "name": "ruflo-jujutsu",
  "description": "Advanced git workflows with diff analysis, risk scoring, change classification (feature/bugfix/refactor/...), and reviewer recommendations — wraps 6 analyze_* MCP tools (diff, diff-risk, diff-classify, diff-reviewers, file-risk, diff-stats). As a mod (ADR-445): a PR-text and merge/close guard, /jujutsu-mod, and a status file the console shows",
  "version": "0.3.3",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "jujutsu",
    "git",
    "diff",
    "review",
    "risk-analysis",
    "mcp",
    "change-classification",
    "reviewer-recommendation",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks",
    "guard"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Guard",
      "description": "Refuse tool calls that are clearly harmful in this plugin's domain (see README, As a mod).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "confirmPrActions": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Confirm PR merge and close",
      "description": "Require confirm: true on github_pr_manage merge and close.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
